Implement the supplied pattern mechanism even when its expected performance benefit is uncertain or could be zero. Do not choose NO_CHANGE because you think the change may be ineffective or slower. Return APPLY with one concrete, minimal workflow change. Preserve triggers, permissions, jobs, matrix, runners, environment, dependencies, shell commands, required checks and all original steps. For caching, add a narrow trusted actions/cache@v4 step or configure caching on an existing setup action. Key it by runner OS and the best available checked-in dependency inputs (lockfiles when present; otherwise dependency manifests, Makefile/install declarations and workflow setup). Cache only dependency download state, use exact keys without broad restore fallbacks, and always run every original install and test command on cache hits. Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Tag, or commit SHA to checkout (optional)"
        required: false

env:
  CI: "true"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [24, 26]
    name: Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    steps:
      # https://github.com/actions/checkout/tree/v6.0.3
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.ref || github.ref }}
      - name: Setup Node ${{ matrix.node }}
        # https://github.com/actions/setup-node/tree/v6.3.0
        uses: actions/setup-node@53b83947a5a98c8d113130e565377fae1a50d02f
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm install --ignore-scripts
      - run: npm run yaml
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run ci

"}, {"path": "Makefile", "text": "npmbin := $(shell npm bin)

all: lint lib yaml attributions docs
	npm test

yaml: data/holidays.json

data/holidays.json: data/countries/*.yaml data/names.yaml
	npm run yaml

lib: src/*
	npm run transpile

test: v12. v14. v15.

v%:
	n $@; \
	npm run clean:all; \
	npm i && \
	npm run ci

dist:
	npm run webpack

docs: tree README.md
	npx markedpp --github -i docs/specification.md -o docs/specification.md
	npx markedpp --github -i README.md -o README.md

lint:
	npm run lint

tree: yaml
	node scripts/addtree.js

writetests: yaml
	$(npmbin)/mocha test/all.mocha.js --writetests

attributions: LICENSE

gitChanges:
	@git diff-files --quiet # fail if unstaged changes
	@git diff-index --quiet HEAD # fail if uncommited changes

gh-pages: gitChanges
	git checkout gh-pages
	git merge --no-ff -X theirs master
	cp -r examples/browser/index* .
	git add .
	git commit -a -m 'chore(gh-pages): update'
	git checkout master

push: gitChanges
	git push origin master
	git push origin gh-pages -f

LICENSE: data/countries/*.yaml
	node scripts/attributions.js

.PHONY: all doc lint test tree writetests yaml dist gitChanges gh-pages push
